description: This file contains a single exported function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of cost records, grouping and organizing data for visualization in Recharts. It generates a dataset with consistent categories across agents, filling zeros where data is missing.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for Recharts, with options for sorting and label customization. It ensures all categories are represented for each agent, filling missing data with zeros.
